objective_contribution: Retain fully accounted local failures without sacrificing later independent evidence, reducing wasted model tokens while allowing the unchanged 8K state hypothesis to reach a complete denominator.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can a fully accounted local branch failure remain failed while later independent frozen cells continue without weakening shared integrity stops?

measurement_mapping.native: Only valid paired native scores estimate evidence-selection usefulness; isolated failures remain missing outcomes in the full denominator.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirmed delivery, displacement, exact state presentation and independently scored later evidence use remain required.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify terminal failure class, complete model accounting, result digest, identity, ancestry, no rerun, explicit local-failure ledger and shared-stop behavior.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token in prefixes, completed branches, failed branches, corrections and terminal requests under 96,000; tokenizer failures add no model tokens.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Failure isolation is reusable infrastructure, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K round cannot establish larger-window, model, domain, repair-correctness or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort. Round 18 is immutable historical evidence. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No tuning, replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/state/scorer change or favorable rerun. Only fully accounted local branch failures may cease to censor later independent cells.

retained_counterevidence: Round 18 stopped after 24 of 56 cells, leaving 32 unstarted.
Nine complete pairs had mean span F1 delta +0.2562, file F1 delta +0.2169 and model-token delta -13,296.4.
One of nine span pairs and one of nine file pairs favored control.
Task 4 state repetition 1 completed, but its control hit a request-tokenizer deadline with zero response bytes.
The failed branch had zero unknown model usage and H29 correctly did not retry its excluded deadline class.
H29 live retry remained unexercised, H25 remains decision-ineligible, and transfer, correctness and clearance remain unproved.
successor_rule: Prove local-versus-shared failure classification offline, then freeze and run every Round 19 identity once. Retain local failures in the denominator while continuing independent cells; any shared failure still stops. Review H28 separately from H25. Every successor passes policy v4 exact-value continuity.

criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Failure isolation, native quality, retention, integrity, transfer and every model input/output token remain separate.
